section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Well-being measure used, specifically the 5-item Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS) by Diener et al. (1985). It details that the scale measures global life satisfaction or subjective well-being using a 7-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree). No specific studies or sample subsets are mentioned.
section_summary.evidence_source: The 5-item Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS; Diener, Emmons, Larsen, & Griffin, 1985) measured global life satisfaction, or subjective well-being. Responses were provided using a 7-point scale; rated from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree).
